title: Saudi Arabia’s Strikes in Iraq Mark Entry Into U.S.-Iran War.
summary_full: The kingdom’s defense ministry said airstrikes in Iraq targeting Iran-backed militias were in retaliation for attacks on Saudi oil facilities this week.
